coordinateConvention: Pixel bounds and anchors use top-left origin; Unity pivot is normalized bottom-left origin.
artRule: Separate raised pointed angular grass clumps, fringe and low joined patches, with broad flat sage planes and a single dark teal shadow; no grass paint on ground and no succulent art.

assets.anchorMeaning: bottom/contact of visible art, top-left pixel origin
assets.placement: Place sparsely on grass terrain; nonblocking visual overlay. Pivot is logical cell center; visible contact lies at local image y=176.
assets.sorting: Depth-sort with props by contact anchor. Draw above grass base and cliff, behind props whose contact is farther forward.
assets.source: V11 built-in imagegen flat angular native redraw; mechanical crop, alpha cleanup, uniform resampling and original canvas placement only
assets.artRule: Corresponding V11 short angular grass design, fitted to the original optional raised-grass canvas and anchor. No succulent leaf design remains.
